dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle at the bottom of the frame.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear smooth on the illuminated side; the shadowed margin is obscured by high-contrast shadow and water-surface interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; visible on the high-reflectance hemisphere of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp, linear transition boundary along the longitudinal axis between the illuminated white surface and the deep shadowed region.

other_distinctive_markers: Extreme longitudinal bi-tonal lighting effect creates a stark division between white and dark-grey/blue across the dorsal plane.
